policy.last_change: 4 Mar 2026 (-25bp, eff. 5 Mar); held 9 Apr, 6 May and 2 Jun

policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 11 Jun close (1x4 3.86, 3x6 3.96, 6x9 4.13, 9x12 4.31 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 45bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 2 Jun (May CPI eased mainly on food; decisions stay data-dependent); Glapiński (3 Jun): lower May CPI cuts the hike odds, rates are high enough and there is no reason to change or even discuss them. Dąbrowski (10 Jun): no reason to hike after the CPI fall, room even for cuts if the world calms; Masłowska (9 Jun): cuts more likely than hikes. May flash CPI 3.1% (29 May; 3.7% expected, -0.3% m/m on food); core 3.0% in April. The fuel VAT and excise cuts run to 15 June (extended 28 May).
policy.risk_text: MPC members now call cuts more likely than hikes (Masłowska 9 Jun, Dąbrowski 10 Jun) while the ECB hiked on 11 Jun and the Fed is priced for a 2026 hike; risks: the Iran deal failing, the fuel package ending (excise 15 Jun, VAT after 30 Jun) and two PLN 6-12bn sales (17, 24 Jun).

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%; EC (21 May): GDP 3.5% in 2026; OECD (June outlook): CPI 3.7% in 2026, no cuts before Q2 2027; Fitch (8 Jun): GDP 3.3%, NBP flat at 3.75% to year-end; World Bank (11 Jun): GDP 3.1% / 2.6%. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after April PLN 89.3bn (30.1% of the limit); the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; EC (21 May): 6.5%, debt 64.5%; EKF consensus (2 Jun): 6.9%; EDP debt 61.6% of GDP at end-Q1 (10 Jun); 2027 budget path (9 Jun): GDP 3.1%, CPI 2.5%; windfall-tax draft cut to a 60% rate, PLN 3.8bn in 2026 (11 Jun); fuel package (VAT 8%, price caps, minimum excise) to 15 June (28 May).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~56% (MoF, 29 May) financed; budget accounts PLN 208.3bn at end-May (MoF, 8 Jun); 3 Jun switch (MoF database): PLN 11.63bn sold (demand 12.84bn) vs 10.90bn bought back (PS0527 7.42bn), net +0.73bn; OK0129 4.812%, PS0731 5.269%, DS0436 5.703%; BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds (2 Jun). S&P A-/stable (affirmed 8 May); Scope A negative (15 May); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks; Fitch's June forecast round (8 Jun) was not a rating action.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun; May CPI 3.1% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.5% y/y (second estimate). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 11 Jun: POLGB yields fell again as the market priced fewer NBP hikes (PKO's Adamiak), though large borrowing needs keep yields high; EUR/PLN ~4.256. ECB +25bp as expected. Windfall-tax draft: rate cut to 60% from 75%, 2026 take PLN 3.8bn (from 4.75bn). Motyka: no decision yet on extending CPN. World Bank kept Poland's GDP at 3.1%/2.6%. Funds took in PLN 2.7bn in May (Millennium). Abroad: the ECB hiked 25bp (DFR 2.25%, unanimous), raised its 2026 HICP forecast to 3.0% and stays meeting-by-meeting; the next hike is priced for September. Trump threatened 'very hard' strikes and seizing Kharg, then cancelled them and said a deal was reached; Brent -4.8% to ~$88.6, Wall Street +2%. US PPI +1.1% m/m; the CBRT held at 37%; UK Defence Secretary Healey resigned.

calendar.plan_text: MoF June plan (29 May): one switch on 3 Jun (settles 8 Jun; buys back DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126, OK0127, PS0527) and sale auctions on 17 and 24 Jun (PLN 6-12bn each) in OK0129, NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; no T-bills; ~56% of 2026 needs financed. 3 Jun switch (MoF database): PLN 11.63bn sold (demand 12.84bn) vs 10.90bn bought back (PS0527 7.42bn), net +0.73bn; OK0129 4.812%, PS0731 5.269%, DS0436 5.703%. BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds on 2 Jun; FPC switch on 18 Jun (buys back FPC0427).
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining June operations: 17 Jun, 24 Jun. Next MPC in July, with the NBP projection: a hold is expected.

facts.core_text: Regime: the ECB has started hiking (11 Jun) while a US-Iran deal takes shape; the NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun while FRAs price roughly 45bp of NBP hikes; the ECB hiked to 2.25% on 11 Jun with one more hike priced, the Fed is priced for a 2026 hike, the BoE is priced for hikes, the CNB is on hold and the MNB is on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 52bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 267bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 11 Jun close). ECB hikes to 2.25%; Trump: Iran deal (11 Jun).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds on 2 Jun (8Y EUR 1.25bn, 15Y EUR 0.75bn; demand EUR 4.6bn); FPC switch on 18 Jun (buys back FPC0427).
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
